correctness.rationale: The q-even fixed-point-free involution and full alphabet are explicit. The two-ended greedy-arch argument proves index 2t+delta with delta exactly the complement-pair transversal property; uniqueness of arch factorization plus Stirling counts proves the rational bivariate generating function; the qh length lower bound and exact forced arch lengths prove shortest multiplicities. The standalone checker verifies all 35,856 specified half-words against the definition and cross-checks finite coefficients by independent automaton and surjection techniques. Finite tests are not substituted for the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Checked published arch, palindrome, permutation-concatenation, unrestricted enumeration and regular-language counting results against exact implication. No found source states the fixed-point reverse-complement length-by-index distribution or sharp minimum-length counts. The method uses known greedy arches and elementary surjection identities, but their application to the symmetry-constrained full index distribution and parity-distinct extremizers is not an immediate stated corollary. Residual risks include independent rederivations elsewhere and equivalent pseudopalindrome terminology.
residual_risks: An unlocated pseudopalindrome/Watson-Crick word enumeration might already contain an equivalent bivariate distribution.

The central arch-count argument is close to the 2020 established palindrome and permutation-concatenation machinery, so originality rests on the full fixed-point enumeration and shortest multiplicities, not on inventing arch factorization.
Not every page of every adjacent source was read; see source_inspections for material actually inspected.

value.rationale: The result exactly enumerates a natural symmetry-fixed subclass of subsequence-universal words for all even alphabet sizes and lengths, including a sharp constrained optimal-length spectrum. Reverse-complement symmetry has natural formal-language and complement-paired sequence meaning; the parity contrast with ordinary palindrome index is mathematical, not just a numerical improvement. The complete fixed-point index distribution was not implied by unrestricted counts in inspected sources.
